name: faithfulness-precision-spl-prompt-falcon-benchmarking
description: This benchmark measures the faithfulness/precision of model outputs under SPL-style prompting (example: Falcon) by assessing whether generated claims are supported by reference evidence. It evaluates per-claim precision and related metrics using automated matching and label comparisons, aiming to quantify hallucination and factual precision under different prompt settings.
reputation: A small, model-focused dataset by onepaneai used for targeted benchmarking of faithfulness; limited broader adoption.
